title: Fylgja deployment 1
description: A driver's plan: the pure, runtime-specific binding of one bundle to one twin. The reconcile loop stores it, hands it to the driver's apply, compares two of them to decide a step's lifecycle actions, and reports its fidelity.
$comment: PURITY. plan(bundle, packages, twin, allocation) -> deployment has no I/O, clock or environment, exactly as the compiler; it is tested by fixtures, one bundle rendered by each driver. Admission (does the demand fit) is a separate, impure check that reads the plan. FILES. The rendered artifacts (for the local driver: topology.clab.yml naming the lab after the twin, with production names where the kind has aliases and renamed ports where not; for clabernetes: namespace.yaml, networkpolicy.yaml and topology.yaml, a Topology wrapping the same containerlab definition less its mgmt block; for hardware later: a device assignment) are stored beside this document under deployments/<id>/ in the state store; this document lists them by path and SHA-256. ID. The deployment id is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of {"driver", "twin", "bundle_id", "files"} taken from this document: fidelity and demand are derived from the same inputs and are not hashed, so rewording a package moves neither a bundle nor a deployment id, while a changed image does (it changes a rendered file). A changed resource request moves the id only where the driver renders it into a file (clabernetes' pod requests in the Topology), not locally, where it is an admission budget (D-015). Planning the same bundle for the same twin on the same driver with the same allocation gives the same id, which makes apply idempotent.

deployment_version.description: The format's version; the reconcile loop refuses a stored deployment of any other and re-plans.

id.description: The deployment's content address; the twin record's status.deployment_id names it and the loop compares it to decide whether apply has work.

driver.description: The driver that planned it; the loop hands it back to that driver's apply.

twin.description: The twin it is bound to; the plan names the isolation unit (lab, namespace) and labels every resource with it.

allocation.description: What admit() reserved for this twin and recorded in its twin record by compare-and-set, passed to the pure plan as an input (D-017): containerlab {lab, mgmt_subnet, demand}, two labs on one host needing disjoint subnets; clabernetes {namespace, core_namespace, controller_namespace, pod_cidr, registries, demand}: the twin's namespace and what the site decides that the plan writes, the core's namespace absent off the cluster, registries mapping each pull credential's key to its image prefix (D-057); hardware {reservation, devices}. demand {nodes, cpu, memory_mb} is what admit reserved of the runtime's room, refreshed by a step to its target's (D-073). Its shape is the driver's; it is not hashed itself, and reaches the id through the files it shapes (D-044).

bundle_id.description: The bundle it binds; the push reads the bundle's files by it.

path.description: The rendered file's path under the deployment's directory; the driver's apply reads it.

sha256.description: The rendered file's SHA-256; hashed into the id, and checked by apply before it uses the stored file.

files.description: The runtime artifacts the plan rendered, sorted by path; apply consumes them. On clabernetes: the Namespace (PSA privileged, labelled), a NetworkPolicy that admits only the twin's own pods, clabernetes' namespace, non-pod sources and the core's namespace (D-019, D-059), and the Topology. No Secret is a file: apply makes each pull secret from the credential provider (D-057).

nodes.description: Runtime nodes the deployment creates or claims, probe hosts included; admission and show read it.

cpu.description: The sum of the packages' per-node cpu; admission compares it with the driver's free capacity.

memory_mb.description: The sum of the packages' per-node memory_mb; admission compares it with the driver's free capacity.

demand.description: What the deployment needs; admission refuses a twin that cannot fit (rule admission.capacity).

fidelity.description: What this twin on this runtime models, approximates, synthesizes and omits; show, the plan answer and the orchestrator's report state it.

driver.description: A driver's name as GET /v1/drivers lists it (containerlab, clabernetes; hardware later).

package.description: The platform id or probe format whose package asserts it; a client groups approximations by it.

text.description: The package's sentence, verbatim; a client shows it.

device.description: The device the omitted interface is on; a client names it.

interface.description: The omitted production interface; a client names it.

omission.description: Why: out of the rule's range, no rule matched, a further management-only interface where the twin has one management port (all three from the bundle's mapping), or its renamed port is held by a cabled interface (this deployment's rename).

approximations.description: Every loaded package's approximations for the platforms and probe formats the bundle uses; a client shows them.

omitted.description: Interfaces the twin does not represent, sorted by (device, interface); a client shows them.

synthesized.description: Nodes the twin adds that intent does not hold (probe hosts), sorted; a client shows them.

compile_fidelity.description: The runtime-independent part of fidelity, answered by POST /v1/bundles; asserted, never measured.

forwarding.description: How the twin's nodes forward on this runtime (containers software, a hardware pool silicon), from the driver's capabilities; a client shows it beside the approximations.

approximations.description: As the compile's; a client shows them.

omitted.description: The compile's omissions plus this deployment's shared ports, sorted; a client shows them.

synthesized.description: As the compile's; a client shows them.

mappings.description: Interfaces whose rename dropped a placeholder; a client warns when non-zero.

shared_ports.description: Runtime ports two or more interfaces renamed onto; a client warns when non-zero.

lossy.description: Counts of the rename's many-to-one mappings; both 0 where every kind has aliases.

deployment_fidelity.description: Fidelity for this twin on this runtime; asserted, never measured.
